title: Golok tibba le xongolo
intro: waktit wadir maaqatta caylale ummattay inki adda hirigte manoh marvel aqayyaareh. kaxxiini kee giddiliino ken sarrimaane alfimteh. Atu aydaadu gorrissam duuddaaay, ta diraamaatiik maynaqih ximmol tekkem maca kinnim taaxigem duuddaa?
clues: Anu ken maqar kee saduh yamixxige caylale ummattah qibaadah gibbatuh ruube.
Anu baxsale assakat luk suge-- yi ceela mari inkinah ken fanat mayanbulla.
Anu qeelak maqub lee inni ummatta lih gersi ayroorah addat kurruumak suge.
oson yok faxe biyak sissik digaala baaheleemih takkaawisen.
keenik kaxxam alliiliyya maabitina habbalteh yoo xagteh.
yi rabak lakal, dagaak inki cankaxih weeqa inkih tan yi ummatta finqiseh.
verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
